correctness.rationale: Starting from the exact source formula, set A=(alpha^2-1)/2, b=alpha-1 and w=(1-|z|^2)/(1-z). For |z|=r, the weighted Schwarzian is bounded by A|w|^2+br|w|+3r^2/2 and |w|<=1+r. At z=r all terms align and |w|=1+r, so the bound is exactly attained; for r>0 the reverse-triangle equality condition makes this maximizer unique. The resulting profile is strictly increasing, so its boundary limit is the exact norm. Any extremizing sequence must have r->1 and |w|->2, which forces z->1.
